# `.github/workflows/`

| Workflow                  | Runs on                                                                                             | Does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ci.yml`                  | pull requests to `main` (including ready for review), pushes to `main`                              | **Quality Gate**: install, Linear key check, format check, lint, typecheck, test, build, `stackra gen` for each service under `services/`, the Squawk lint of the compiled `.stackra/migrations` (ADR 0159 d3), `pnpm validate`, `pnpm boundaries`, `pnpm knip`, `pnpm secrets:scan`, `pnpm agents:check`. `deploy-staging` is a placeholder that deploys nothing until a deploy target is decided                                                                                                                                          |
| `release.yml`             | pushes to `main`                                                                                    | Calls `runway-npm.yml`: Trivy lockfile scan, then changesets: opens or updates the "version packages" PR as `stackra-bot`, publishes released packages to the Stackra registry (`registry`, ADR 0453) with provenance, one OIDC-exchanged token per package (no stored token), and uploads a CycloneDX SBOM. Waits for the owner's approval of the `release` environment                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `deploy-static.yml`       | pushes to `main` touching `workers/static/**` or `tools/schemas/**`, `schemas@*` tags, manual       | Calls `runway-cloudflare-workers.yml`: tests and builds `workers/static`, then `wrangler deploy` of the `stackra-static` Worker (static.stackra.figentra.com) with `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` from Infisical `/ci` over OIDC; skips the deploy with a notice until `INFISICAL_CI_IDENTITY_ID` is set ([ADR 0284](../../apps/docs/src/docs/adr/0284-hosted-static-files-one-cloudflare-static-assets-worker.mdx))                                                                                                                                |
| `deploy-docs.yml`         | pushes to `main` touching `apps/docs/**`, manual                                                    | Calls `runway-mintlify.yml`: builds `@stackra/cli`, `stackra build` (gen assembles `.stackra/site`, mint validate) and `stackra lint` (broken-links, a11y), a Mintlify update with `MINTLIFY_ADMIN_KEY` from Infisical `/ci`, a smoke test; skips the deploy until `MINTLIFY_PROJECT_ID` and the identity exist                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `apply-observability.yml` | pushes to `main` touching `packages/infrastructure/infra-observability/**` or `runway.yaml`, manual | Tests and builds `@stackra/infra-observability`, then `pulumi up` (manual: `preview` unless `apply` is ticked) of its `pulumi/` project in the `observability` environment (required reviewer): Better Stack uptime monitors of the registry, static and turbo-cache Workers, the OTLP source and the status page. Secrets from Infisical `/ci/observability` over OIDC; applies nothing until the repository variable `OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED` is `true` ([Monitoring runbook](../../apps/docs/src/docs/runbooks/monitoring.mdx), STA-1573) |
| `runway-*.yml`            | `workflow_call` only                                                                                | Runway's public provider workflows (`cloudflare-workers`, `npm`, `mintlify`), released as `runway-v<n>` tags ([Runway runbook](../../apps/docs/src/docs/runbooks/runway.mdx))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `linear-sync.yml`         | nightly, pushes to `main`, manual (with dry run)                                                    | `tools/scripts/linear-reconcile.mjs`: moves Linear issues to match merged and open PRs, closes decided ADR issues and labels stale work. Never fails the run                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

## Rules

- Least privilege ([ADR 0019](../../apps/docs/src/docs/adr/0019-supply-chain-hardening.mdx) D2): `permissions` at the
  workflow is read-only or empty, and a job asks only for what it needs.
- No token is a repository secret: CI logs in to Infisical by GitHub OIDC for one step and reads `/ci` only
  ([ADR 0009](../../apps/docs/src/docs/adr/0009-secrets-two-mechanisms.mdx)).
- Third-party actions are pinned to a commit SHA, with the version in a comment.
- The toolchain comes from `mise.toml`, so CI runs the same versions as a contributor.

Runbooks: [CI](../../apps/docs/src/docs/runbooks/ci.mdx), [release](../../apps/docs/src/docs/runbooks/release.mdx).
